nodes.summary: For vectors $u = (u_0, u_1)$ and $v = (v_0, v_1)$ in the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, $\det(u, v) = u_0 v_1 - u_1 v_0$, the signed area of the parallelogram spanned by $u$ and $v$.
nodes.title: Planar determinant for the Umlaufsatz

nodes.summary: Let $r : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^2$ be a positively oriented simple closed unit-speed plane curve: $r$ is continuously differentiable and $2\pi$-periodic, injective on $[0, 2\pi)$, satisfies $\lVert r'(t) \rVert = 1$ for all $t$, and has positive signed area $\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{2\pi} \det(r(t), r'(t))\,dt > 0$, where $\det(u, v) = u_0 v_1 - u_1 v_0$. Let $\alpha : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuously…
nodes.title: Hopf's Umlaufsatz

nodes.summary: A curve $r : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^2$ in the Euclidean plane is a positively oriented simple closed unit-speed curve when it is continuously differentiable, periodic with period $2\pi$, injective on $[0, 2\pi)$, has velocity of norm $\lVert r'(t) \rVert = 1$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$, and has positive signed area $\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{2\pi} \det(r(t), r'(t))\,dt > 0$, where $\det(u, v) = u_0 v_1 - u_1 v_0$.
nodes.title: Positively oriented simple closed unit-speed curve

nodes.summary: For a curve $r : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^2$ in the Euclidean plane, a function $\alpha : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is a tangent-angle lift of $r$ when $\alpha$ is continuously differentiable and the velocity of $r$ satisfies $r'(t) = (\cos \alpha(t), \sin \alpha(t))$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Tangent-angle lift

nodes.summary: The parameter period of the closed curves in the Hopf Umlaufsatz is the real number $2\pi$.
nodes.title: Parameter period for the Umlaufsatz

nodes.summary: The Euclidean plane is the space $\mathbb{R}^2$ of pairs of real numbers with the Euclidean inner product and norm.
nodes.title: Euclidean plane for the Umlaufsatz

nodes.summary: For a curve $r : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^2$, the signed area is $\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{2\pi} \det(r(t), r'(t))\,dt$, where $r'$ is the velocity of $r$ and $\det(u, v) = u_0 v_1 - u_1 v_0$ (Green's normalization). Its sign fixes the orientation convention.
nodes.title: Signed area of a closed plane curve

nodes.summary: For a function $\alpha : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $t \in \mathbb{R}$, the signed curvature of $\alpha$ at $t$ is the derivative $\alpha'(t)$, taken to be $0$ where $\alpha$ is not differentiable at $t$.
nodes.title: Signed curvature

nodes.summary: For a function $\alpha : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, the total signed curvature is $\int_0^{2\pi} \alpha'(t)\,dt$, the integral of the signed curvature $\alpha'$ over one parameter period $[0, 2\pi]$.
nodes.title: Total signed curvature of a tangent-angle lift

nodes.summary: For a curve $r : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^2$ in the Euclidean plane and $t \in \mathbb{R}$, the velocity of $r$ at $t$ is its derivative $r'(t) \in \mathbb{R}^2$, taken to be $0$ where $r$ is not differentiable.
nodes.title: Velocity of a plane curve

stated.label: statement formalized
